text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp Friday again extended its $55 per share tender offer for 50.1 percent of ITT Corp's common stock until midnight, August 29.
The hostile offer had been set to expire at midnight tonight. To date, about 950,000 shares of ITT common have been tendered, Hilton said in a statement.
ITT has about 122.7 million shares outstanding.

Beverly Hills-based Hilton, one of the nation's largest hotel and gambling companies launched its $6.5 billion, two step bid for ITT Corp in late January with an eye toward owning ITT's Sheraton brand hotels and Ceasars brand casinos.

Since then, New York-based ITT has fended off Hilton's aggressive legal attacks and sold some assets to raise cash and focus on core businesses. Moreover, ITT earlier this month announced a comprehensive defense that included splitting the company into three parts, buying back stock at $70 a share and refinancing debt.
Hilton has said it would try to block ITT's plans in federal court.
